help: Only this origin and path prefix are allowed. Requests cannot replace the destination.
label: API root URL
URL racine de l’API

help: Explicit allowed methods. Default GET and HEAD; mutations need deliberate configuration.
label: Allowed methods
Méthodes autorisées

help: The wallet resolves credentials server-side. Inputs never set authentication headers.
label: Authentication
Authentification

help: Secret reference, never the credential itself. Required for bearer or custom-header authentication.
label: Wallet secret reference
Référence du secret wallet

help: Custom authentication header when mode is header, for example X-API-Key. Routing headers are forbidden.
label: Authentication header
En-tête d’authentification

help: Total call deadline, including DNS, redirects and all pages. Cancellation terminates the owned worker.
label: Total timeout (s)
Délai total (s)

help: Maximum UTF-8 JSON input bytes, including the body.
label: Request limit (bytes)
Limite de requête (octets)

help: Maximum accumulated response body bytes across all pages. No truncated success.
label: Response limit (bytes)
Limite de réponse (octets)

help: GET pagination via a constrained Link rel=next header; same origin and root. One page disables automatic pagination.
label: Maximum pages
Nombre maximal de pages

help: GET/HEAD only, at most two redirects, same allowed origin and root. Mutations are never replayed.
label: Follow safe redirects
Suivre les redirections sûres

help: Allow loopback/private LAN destinations explicitly. Link-local, metadata and multicast destinations remain denied.
label: Allow private network
Autoriser le réseau privé

help: Allow unencrypted HTTP without credentials. Authentication still requires verified HTTPS.
label: Allow plain HTTP
Autoriser HTTP non chiffré

help: Optional existing PEM CA file for a private HTTPS service. Empty uses system trust; TLS verification cannot be disabled.
label: Custom CA file
Fichier CA personnalisé
